name: Remington ONE 2-in-1 Flat Iron + Curling Iron Styler (Model S33A)
description: Selling a highly versatile Remington ONE 2-in-1 Flat Iron and Curler (Model: S33A / S33A10) [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W7TK3wVd_aM). This multi-styling game changer features innovative sliding FlexiCovers that seamlessly transform the device from a 1.25-inch smooth ceramic flat iron into a 1.25-inch (32mm) curling iron or styling wand. Engineered with an advanced dual-heat system, it heats the plates up to 450°F and the outer barrel up to 410°F separately depending on your mode selection, boasting an ultra-fast 20-second heat-up time. Features ceramic titanium styling surfaces and a built-in digital display with 5 adjustable heat settings. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly apartment with a resident cat. The styler has been completely cleaned and sanitized, though minor pet dust particles might remain due to plastic/metal static. It does NOT come with any secondary retail storage packaging or pouch bags, so local pickup buyers, please bring your own tote container.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled and multi-functional. Exceptionally lightweight and travel-friendly. From a cat-friendly apartment; please bring your own pickup bag.

name_zh: 雷明登 Remington ONE 2合1夹板直发梳 / 卷发棒两用美发棒 (型号 S33A)
description_zh: 低价转让一个功能强大的雷明登（Remington）ONE系列二合一直卷两用美发器（官方型号：S33A / S33A10）[TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@remington.uk/video/7434914249664711969)。这款网红美发工具采用独家创新的可滑动 FlexiCovers 面板护罩设计 [Manual](https://device.report/manual/10603553)，只需轻轻一滑，即可在 1.25 英寸的陶瓷直发夹板与 1.25 英寸（32mm）大波浪卷发棒/卷发棒之间无缝切换。搭载双发热系统，直发模式下夹板可达 450°F，卷发模式下外桶可达 410°F，且拥有 20 秒极速预热和 5 档数码液晶温度显示。**诚实披露**：家里养猫，属于宠物友好型环境。出货前整个机身及发热板已整体用酒精全面擦拭清洁与静电除尘，但外壳可能会有不可避免的轻微使用痕迹或浮尘吸附。本美发工具不含原厂外包装纸箱或额外的收纳布袋，本地自提的买家朋友请自带一个小提袋将其带走。
